context: Hina and Sho observe a bug in the garden.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、見て、この小さい虫。
lines.en: Sho, look — this tiny bug here.
lines.style: Bright, immediate opening. High and eager. Tugging at his attention with genuine wonder. Each word lands clearly — a child sharing something small and precious. Warm throughout, no performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Wow — that's interesting. The colors are so pretty.
lines.style: Small, genuine gasp on the opening. Soft appreciative tone. Leans in close to look. Real discovery in his voice — not mimicking excitement but actually noticing something beautiful. Warm and quiet.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: There's so much in nature. All kinds of things.
lines.style: Wondering, philosophical turn for an eight-year-old. Slower pace, like the thought is forming as she speaks. Soft sense of awe threading through. Still childish, but touching something bigger than the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, offering the idea like a small gift. Gentle proposal rather than demand. His soft voice carries something tender — wanting to share this with her. Small and sincere throughout.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah. We can draw it later.
lines.style: Immediate agreement, then the plan unfolds. Bright with the next idea. Forward momentum but unhurried. Warm closure — the thought of extending this moment into art. Real childish contentment in the trailing off.
